map.9×9 盘面，生成时按难度挖空并保证唯一解；求解用回溯法逐格试数满足行/列/宫不: A 9x9 grid; when generated, cells are removed by difficulty while guaranteeing a unique solution; solving uses backtracking to try numbers cell by cell so that row/column/box have no repeats. A pasted puzzle can also be solved in reverse. ...
map.休闲练习：选难度一键生成题目，附参考答案。: Casual practice: pick a difficulty and generate a puzzle with one click, with a reference answer attached.
map.求解辅助：粘贴卡住的题目，工具回溯求解给出完整盘。: Solving aid: paste a puzzle you are stuck on and the tool backtracks to a complete grid.
map.教学演示：理解约束满足与回溯算法。: Teaching demonstration: understand constraint satisfaction and backtracking.
map.生成的题一定唯一解吗？: Is the generated puzzle guaranteed to have a unique solution?
map.是。生成流程会校验唯一解，确保有且仅有一个合法填法。: Yes. The generation process verifies the unique solution, ensuring there is exactly one legal filling.
map.能自己调难度吗？: Can I set the difficulty myself?
map.可通过挖空数选难度；极难可手动再挖，但过多可能破坏唯一解。: Difficulty can be set through the number of cells removed; for extreme difficulty you can remove more manually, but too many may destroy the unique solution.
